author: Arnav
problem: Friends each paid part of a restaurant bill; all amounts are in dollars and cents. Return whether their payments together cover the bill.
bug_description: Compares the raw floating-point sum with the bill instead of rounding it to cents first, so totals like 0.7 + 0.1 = 0.7999999999999999 fall just short.

comments.accurate: True when the payments add up to at least the bill
comments.wrong_behavior: True when the running total of the payments reaches the bill exactly or goes over it
comments.wrong_location: Total verified; the bill may need rounding to cents before the comparison
